description.text:
Gem Pack (宝可梦卡牌 宝石包) Volume 4 came out on 6 February 2026, as the Chinese New Year of the Horse drew near, and Pokémon China introduced it with Ponyta. As in the earlier volumes, every card is a holo, four to a pack. Each of its Pokémon comes in several finishes of the same art, among them a pattern of its Energy type, a Master Ball pattern and a gold-foil Gem Pack logo, and every Pokémon in the volume also has an art illustration card. Ponyta's shows it leaping across a wide grassland at sunset while a Rapidash watches over it.

This volume holds only Pokémon: 28 of them, among them Ponyta, Eevee, Infernape, Froslass, Meltan, Enamorus and Flutter Mane, each in seven versions. The cards are numbered with four digits, the first two for the Pokémon, from 01 for Ponyta to 28 for Flutter Mane, and the last two for the version, out of 07.
